uq_article_resources_snapshot_binding.name: uq_article_resources_snapshot_binding
uq_article_resources_snapshot_binding.where: "content"."article_resources"."frozen_by_snapshot_id" is not null and "content"."article_resources"."deleted_at" is null

ck_copy_records_failure_reason.name: ck_copy_records_failure_reason
ck_copy_records_failure_reason.value: ("content"."copy_records"."status" = 'success' and "content"."copy_records"."failure_reason" is null) or ("content"."copy_records"."status" = 'failed' and "content"."copy_records"."failure_reason" is not null)

uq_users_username_active.name: uq_users_username_active
uq_users_username_active.where: "auth"."users"."username" is not null and "auth"."users"."deleted_at" is null
